messages:
Zoe: quick follow-up from the postmortem 1 - i captured a tiny set of defenses we should ship this sprint to reduce rollout blast radius.
Cal: thanks. recap of failure: unscoped flag + fast ramp + no client fallback. we can fix at schema + runtime + ops layers.
Hector: runtime idea: two-signal pause (ewma error 3m, p95 latency multiplier) + min evidence window 3m, then auto-rollback if pause persists > 10m. avoid noisy single-signal rollbacks.
Nora: will own schema+CI changes: add fields `sample_scope` (org_tag|cohort|global), `max_tokens_per_request`, `fallback_variant`. will add lint to block global defaults. ETA: 2025-05-04.
Cal: client change: SDK supports immediate `fallback_variant` switch and local token cap. i'll open PR. ETA: 2025-05-03.
Zoe: ops/UI: add console "quarantine" + fast-unpublish action that requires reason and creates audit entry. ops only for quick demote.
Hector: detector prototype: i'll emit `canary_health_score` and implement the two-signal rule. scent tests + EWMA smoothing. ETA: 2025-05-06.
ops-bot: [card] PM-5012 created: "flag-defense & rollback playbook" assigned.
Zoe: action items (short):
- Nora: schema PR + CI guard (due 2025-05-04)
- Cal: SDK fallback & token cap PR (due 2025-05-03)
- Hector: detector + canary_health metric + dashboard (due 2025-05-06)
- Zoe: console quarantine + runbook (due 2025-05-08)
Cal: i'll add a lightweight sim that replays the incident traffic and asserts the pause triggers before the error surge peak. path: `eng-platform/tools/canary_replay.sh`. ETA: 2025-05-05.
Zoe: policy: block ramp >10% without manual approval. allow global only with explicit risk sign-off; otherwise default to `org_tag`.
Hector: sample guard rule we can store in config store:
```
{ "flag_id": "ranker-v3", "scope": "org_tag", "tag": "beta", "sample_pct": 1, "ramp_minutes": [5,15,60], "auto_pause": { "ewma_mins": 3, "err_pct": 2, "latency_mult": 1.5 }, "auto_rollback": { "pause_mins": 10 } }
```
Nora: PRs will include migration notes and tests to ensure templates don't default to global. i'll tag QA to run the replay sim once ready.
Zoe: monthly audit: report flags with exposure_count > 1 in 90d and surface owners for follow-up. add a rotation for flag reviews.
Cal: one more: prevent ramps beyond configured cohorts unless manual opt-in. small friction but big safety.
Zoe: thanks team. i'll add these cards to PM-5012 and schedule a 30m check-in next Tuesday to review staging sims. :thumbsup:
